name: Feature Agent
description: Creates a FeatureAgent that frames around a panel feature (e.g. an opening). Right-click to choose the agent type; its parameters appear as additional inputs. Leave 'feature' empty to make a prototype applied to every matching feature.

inputParameters.name: feature
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Panel feature to bind this agent to. Leave empty for a per-type prototype (CT_PanelPopulator's 'default_feature_configs').

inputParameters.name: element_layers
inputParameters.description: Layers (or layer paths) the agent generates framing on.

inputParameters.name: trimming_layers
inputParameters.description: Layers (or layer paths) on which the agent's outline trims other agents' elements, e.g. sheathing plates.

inputParameters.name: internal_joint_overrides
inputParameters.description: List of joint rules between elements of this agent. Rules matching a default (same topology and categories) replace it; others are added.

inputParameters.name: external_joint_overrides
inputParameters.description: List of joint rules between elements of this agent and those of other agents. Rules matching a default (same topology and categories) replace it; others are added.

outputParameters.name: Agent
outputParameters.description: Configured FeatureAgent. Connect to CT_PanelPopulator's 'agents' (bound) or 'default_feature_configs' (prototype) input.
